title: game/lessons/<id>.json
description: One lesson (C06: one file each; game/lessons.json lists them in order): a list of steps of eight types, so a new lesson needs no code. Loaded by LessonBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core), which also checks the phrases, prompts, speech lines, NPCs and world events named here. The text is the locale's (lesson.<id>.*). Schema 2 (VILLAGE_PLAN V08): every lesson declares its level, and the game's validator holds its Spanish and its tenses to it.

id.description: A stable id (first-words), the file's name; saves name it.

npc.description: The NPC the lesson starts at.

level.description: The level the lesson keeps to (VILLAGE_PLAN 3.9, V08): the game's validator checks the lemmas of the Spanish it teaches and says (its phrases, the lines its steps name, its prompts' text) against the bundle's lists up to that level (cefr/a1.txt; at a2 also cefr/a2.txt), and its tenses: pres, pret and ir-a at a1, fut as well at a2. The bundle's ceiling is a2 (the gate's lint); its phrases' variants, which the learner may say instead, are held to the ceiling.

autoStart.description: The lesson starts when the player first talks to its NPC.

after.description: An earlier lesson of the file this one follows.

session.description: The play session it unlocks in (default 1); above 1 the locale needs its objective line (lesson.<id>.objective).

verbs.description: The verb forms the lesson teaches (the book's tables).

npc.description: An NPC by its agent id (agents/<id>.json): guide, shopkeeper, villager.

tense.description: pres, pret and ir-a (the near future) at any level; fut (the simple future) and tener-que (the obligation, tener que + infinitive: the book's column "must", V21b) only in an a2 lesson (the validator checks it).

id.description: Unique within the lesson; saves name it.

attempts.description: How many tries before the step moves on (default 2).

npc.description: The NPC the step is said at, when the lesson moves from one NPC to another.

line.description: model, listen, answer: a speech line id (phrase.hola, guide.lesson.hello.1).

correct.description: listen: the index of the right option (the options are the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.option.<n>).

phrase.description: repeat, answer: a phrase-sheet row the learner says.

prompt.description: repeat, answer: the bundle prompt the answer is evaluated at (default: the row's).

person.description: repeat, answer: the person of the verb the step expects (its retry line is the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.personRetry).

tense.description: repeat, answer: the tense the step expects (its retry line is the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.tenseRetry). At an ir-a step a plan said in the present with a time word or in the simple future is credited with the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.presentNote; at a fut step (the simple future, V16; an a2 lesson only, the validator checks it) the near future or the present with a time word is credited with lesson.<id>.<step>.futureNote.

point.description: do: a noun the beacon points at when the step begins (the step's HUD line is the locale's lesson.<id>.<step>.hud).

pointPlace.description: do (VILLAGE_PLAN V02): a named place of the scene (a site, a point or a named prop: stall, river) the beacon points at when the step begins; a trigger { event: beacon_reached, detail: <the place> } ends the step on arrival. Not with point.

phrases.description: recap: the phrases listed (default: every phrase the lesson teaches).

trigger.description: do: the world event the step waits for, with the npc and the exact detail it must have (C06).

candidates.description: review (X06, R07): the phrases an earlier lesson of the file teaches that the step may ask, each with the existing line of the step's NPC that asks it; at run time the most overdue of those due is asked, and the step is skipped when none is.

step.$comment: Each rule of allOf reads: when the type is one of these, these fields are required (an implication, written with anyOf and not so that every validator reads it).

phrase.description: A phrase-sheet row the learner says, taught by a repeat or answer step of an earlier lesson.

line.description: The speech line the step's NPC asks it with; its meaning is the line's own (line.<id> in the locale).

prompt.description: The bundle prompt the answer is evaluated at (default: the row's).

event.description: The event waited for: a world event (WorldEvents), or for a tip start or aimed_npc.

npc.description: The NPC the event must be about (an agent id).

detail.description: The detail the event must have, exactly (item_picked_up and item_crafted: the noun; torch_at_ring: the ring's name).

trigger.description: What the step or tip waits for (CONTENT_PLAN C06).
